clips.title: The story
paras: Darkshire's council grows bitter as Stormwind overrides its judgment. Councilman Millstipe lives in the town hall and wants justice for Duskwood's people.

Darkshire faces undead and attacks from ferocious beasts, while its council struggles against Stormwind City's bureaucracy. Councilman Millstipe reflects the town's growing bitterness toward the crown. The notorious grave robber Dextren Ward was caught selling freshly dug corpses to the necromancer Morbent Fel. Darkshire's leaders sentenced Ward to death, but Stormwind's House of Nobles commuted the execution and locked him away in the Stormwind Stockade.
